productScope: Domestic callable retail fixed deposits below INR 3 crore; Table 0 (Rows 7 to 18)

sourceReview.basis: Official Canara Bank term deposit rate page HTML. Table 0 contains 12 callable retail rows effective 17.03.2026. Non-callable columns (Col 5-8), annualized yields (Col 2, 4), and bulk tables (Tables 2-5 >= 3 Cr) are strictly excluded. Card rates are strictly separated from yields. Source remains disabled pending human review and governance sign-off.

eligibilityNotes: Senior Citizen rates: Additional 0.50% interest is offered to Senior Citizens for domestic term deposits of less than Rs. 3 Crore with tenure of 180 days and above.
For tenures below 180 days, senior citizen rates are identical to general public card rates.
Senior citizen preferential rates do not apply to NRO, NRE, or Capital Gains deposits.
NRE fixed deposits require a minimum tenure of 1 year. Sub-one-year slabs are not eligible for NRE deposits.
Non-callable deposits (> 1 Cr to < 3 Cr) and bulk deposits (>= 3 Cr) are strictly excluded from callable retail candidates.
Annualized yield represents compounding return and is strictly excluded from card interest rates.
